split_rationale: The MCP group joins tool/ledger data with MCP integration and runtime lifecycle; the archive group joins instruction/ledger data with observation. Workflow preservation shares Legacy healthcheck integration and runtime lifecycle. Host-manifest and installation-evidence criteria are singleton groups under the strict two-kind rule.
